statement: Every finite quotient B/[N,N]N^j used in D.25 is isolated in the gentle GT-shadow groupoid. Its integral cusp correction map has cokernel C2, and adjoining multiplier variation makes it onto. All twenty-four certified G6 automorphisms, including the twelve extra CM pairs, extend compatibly through every abelian-exponent refinement, with lambda congruent to 1 modulo72. A single profinite gauge gives compatible shadows, and an explicit finer S3-based quotient proves this system is not cofinal among all finite quotients.
notes: This is an actual automorphism of the specified profinite quotient G=lim_j B/[N,N]N^j, with kernel Zhat^97 over Q, and a compatible shadow family on that inverse system. Full profinite GT0 liftability is not claimed. Integral Smith forms are checked by exact arithmetic; the augmented Hermite form is independently I97. All24 pairs were checked at exponents2,4,8,16 and3,9,27,81, including384 general-m hexagon identities. The initial shadow multiplier is preserved as m=0 modulo36; finite cusp gauges are chosen by the joint quotient G6 times Fab/36. D.27 later proves that every nonidentity selected G6 action is nongenuine despite these compatible abelian-kernel lifts. Its alternate extra-CM homology action survives both characteristic class-two tests.
